projects.title: SuperSort
projects.goal: Search for genuinely new, architecture-aware mechanisms that make practically relevant sorting tasks substantially faster than the best existing implementations.

latest.title: Updating a chess ranking with monthly FIDE ratings
latest.summary: The frozen direct-span prototype reordered 464,388 FIDE rating records 1.18-1.23× as fast as Rust's unstable full sort, the fastest reference. All 252 calls were correct. Neither cache condition reached the 1.30× target.
latest.result: 1.178-1.230× against Rust's unstable full sort on the June to July 2024 transition
